policy.scope: All 402 exact STR_ITM_* name rows plus short associated equipment/stat labels; no item descriptions or dialogue.
policy.canonicality: Wiki-verified name components and existing glossary spellings win. Project conventions and provisional names are not claims of official English localization.
policy.codes: Preserve numeric IDs, keys, control prefixes, model literals, grade tokens and version digits exactly; translate only player-readable language.
policy.unresolved: Null English means no approved spelling. Research the name before translation; do not replace with a plausible mythological guess.
policy.aliases: Japanese aliases are exact observed UI names. No unobserved source aliases invented.
